_about: Longinus, On the Sublime, in English, translator per title: H. L. Havell (1890), clean Gutenberg; William Smith (1739; this scan the 1752 printing, MDCCLII on its title page) and A. O. Prickard (Oxford, 1906), raw IA OCR. W. Hamilton Fyfe's Loeb (1927) is Greek facing and held back like the other Greek-facing Loebs.

longinus-smith-sublime: Dionysius Longinus on the Sublime, translated from the Greek, with notes and observations (1752 printing)
longinus-prickard-sublime: Longinus on the Sublime (Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1906)
longinus-dublin-graduate-1821: A Literal Translation of Longinus on the Sublime, by a Graduate of Trinity College, Dublin (1821)
tr. anonymous (a Graduate of Trinity College, Dublin)
longinus-spurdens-1836: Longinus on the Sublime in Writing, translated, with notes and three dissertations (London: Longman; Norwich: Bacon, 1836; the title page is anonymous, the dedication is signed William Tylney Spurdens)
longinus-oxford-ma-1841: Longinus on the Sublime, a new translation for English readers in general, by a Master of Arts of the University of Oxford (imprint lost in the OCR; IA gives 1841)
tr. anonymous (a Master of Arts of Oxford)
longinus-stebbing-1867: Longinus on the Sublime (Oxford: T. and G. Shrimpton; London: Whittaker, MDCCCLXVII)
